metadata.description: Answer-first principle, structural elements, language tactics, content types for AEO
metadata.per_source_detail: The per-source detail gathered while building this skill is not redistributed; this list links to the originals.

answer_first_principle.definition: Positioning the direct, complete answer to a query at the very beginning of content, typically within the first 40-60 words
answer_first_principle.rationale: AI systems prioritize content that provides immediate, extractable answers for featured snippets and direct response generation
implementation_structure: First 40-60 words: Direct, complete answer to primary query
Following 100-200 words: Essential context and key supporting details
Remaining content: Comprehensive exploration, examples, and related subtopics

formatting_guidelines.completeness: Answer must be self-contained and understandable without additional context
formatting_guidelines.specificity: Include specific details, numbers, and actionable information
formatting_guidelines.scanability: Use paragraph breaks after answer-first section for visual distinction

hierarchical_headings.purpose: Create clear content structure for AI parsing and human readability
best_practices: Single H1 per page containing primary keyword and query
H2 tags for major section breaks (introduce new subtopics)
H3 tags for subsection details within H2 sections
Use descriptive, question-based headings when appropriate
Maintain logical hierarchy without skipping levels (no H1 to H3 jumps)
hierarchical_headings.aeo_impact: Headings serve as content extractors for AI, marking discrete answer segments

modular_content_design.definition: Structuring content as self-contained, reusable modules that can be extracted and repurposed independently
implementation: Create distinct sections that answer specific questions completely
Ensure each module can stand alone without requiring full page context
Format modules consistently (introduction, answer, supporting detail, transition)
benefits: Easier AI extraction for featured snippets
Improved user experience with scannable sections
Flexibility for content updates without full page rewrites

techniques: Bulleted and numbered lists for sequential or grouped information
Bold text for key terms and important concepts (use sparingly)
Tables for comparative data and structured information
Blockquotes for emphasis and expert citations
White space between sections for visual breathing room
scannable_formatting.purpose: Facilitate rapid content comprehension for both human readers and AI parsers

conversational_tone.definition: Natural, accessible language that mirrors how people speak and ask questions
implementation: Write in second person ('you') to address reader directly
Employ active voice over passive voice
Ask rhetorical questions to introduce topics
Use everyday vocabulary unless technical precision requires jargon
conversational_tone.voice_search_optimization: Conversational language aligns with how users phrase voice queries to AI assistants

question_based_content.approach: Structure content explicitly around questions users are asking
tools_for_research: Semrush Keyword Magic Tool - Question-based keyword filters
Reddit, Quora - Real user questions in communities
implementation: Use questions as H2 or H3 headings
Follow each question heading with immediate, direct answer

long_tail_keywords.definition: Specific, detailed keyword phrases (typically 4+ words) with lower search volume but higher intent and specificity
aeo_advantage: Long-tail queries more likely to trigger AI Overviews
Match conversational voice and ChatGPT queries
Easier to rank for and dominate with comprehensive answer
long_tail_keywords.strategy: Target 70% long-tail keywords vs. 30% head terms in content strategy

clear_definitions.purpose: Immediately define technical terms and jargon to maintain clarity
clear_definitions.implementation: When introducing specialized term, provide definition in same sentence or immediately following
clear_definitions.example: 'We use schema markup—structured data code that helps search engines understand content—throughout our pages.'

faq_pages.format: Question-and-answer pairs addressing common user queries
optimization: Each Q&A pair in its own section
Use FAQPage schema markup for every FAQ
Order questions from most common to least common
Include both basic and advanced questions
faq_pages.aeo_value: Extremely high AI extraction rate for FAQPage schema content

optimization: Number each step clearly (Step 1, Step 2, etc.)
Include estimated time and required materials upfront
Use HowTo schema markup with individual steps defined
Add images or video for each major step
Provide expected outcome or success criteria
how_to_guides.aeo_value: HowTo schema highly favored for AI featured snippets

definition_glossaries.purpose: Establish topical authority through comprehensive term definitions
definition_glossaries.structure: Alphabetical or categorical organization with concise definitions (30-100 words each)
definition_glossaries.schema: Use DefinedTerm schema for each glossary entry
definition_glossaries.strategic_value: Captures wide range of long-tail queries and establishes subject expertise

formats: Product A vs. Product B articles
optimization: Use table format for direct comparisons
Implement Product schema for compared items
Include clear winner or recommendation when appropriate
Address specific comparison queries ('which is better for X?')
comparison_content.aeo_value: Comparison queries common in AI search, tables highly extractable

statistics_and_data_pages.content: Collections of industry statistics, data points, and research findings
optimization: Use table or list format for easy scanning
Include both raw numbers and context/interpretation
statistics_and_data_pages.aeo_advantage: 30-40% higher AI response visibility for content including quotes and statistics
